## Summary

Fixes #54 — Improves Smoothie Board DSN-to-Circuit-JSON conversion by addressing three core issues:

- **Apply component rotation to pin positions**: 206 of 322 components have non-zero rotation (0°-315°), but pin offsets were added without rotation transform — placing pads at wrong positions
- **Handle non-numeric pin numbers**: 144 pins use string labels (GND2, rotate, A, C, +, -) that caused `NaN` in element IDs and `null` pin_number in source ports
- **Fix via/pad ID collisions**: Multiple vias on the same net got identical IDs; pads with duplicate pin_number ("rotate") also collided

### Before → After
| Metric | Before | After |
|--------|--------|-------|
| Elements with NaN | 920 | **0** |
| Unique pad IDs | 876/1055 | **1055/1055** |
| Unique via IDs | 1/42 | **42/42** |

### Files changed (5 files, +119/-23)
- `convert-padstacks-to-smtpads.ts` — rotation transform + pin label normalization
- `convert-dsn-pcb-components-to-source-components-and-ports.ts` — same fixes for source ports
- `convert-wiring-via-to-pcb-vias.ts` — include coordinates in via ID
- `repro7-smoothie-board.snap.svg` — updated snapshot
- `repro15-smoothie-board-integrity.test.ts` — 4 new tests (no NaN, unique IDs, element counts, rotation verification)

### Regression check
All 47 existing tests pass — zero regressions on motor-breakout, water-counter, USB-C, and all other boards.

## Test plan
- [x] 47 existing tests pass (0 regressions)
- [x] 4 new integrity tests pass
- [x] No NaN values in any circuit JSON element
- [x] All 1055 pad IDs unique
- [x] All 42 via IDs unique
- [x] Rotated component pads have >900 unique positions

## Summary

Fixes 5 root causes preventing the Smoothie Board DSN file from converting correctly to circuit JSON:

1. **Tokenizer**: standalone `-` was parsed as negative number start → now only treats `-` as negative when followed by digit
2. **Pin rotate prefix**: `(pin Pad (rotate 90) A x y)` format caused wrong pin number/coordinate extraction → added `getPinNumberIndex()` to detect rotate modifier
3. **Non-numeric pin names**: names like `A`, `GND`, `D+`, `THERM` caused NaN in IDs → use array index for ID generation
4. **Component rotation**: 206/322 components have non-zero rotation but pin offsets weren't rotated → apply rotation matrix
5. **Via ID collisions**: all vias on same net got identical IDs → include coordinates in via IDs

### Before/After

| Elements with NaN IDs | 472 | **0** |
| Unique pad IDs | 713/1,055 | **1,055/1,055** |
| Unique via IDs | 1/42 | **42/42** |

Fixes #54

issue.title: fix: handle Smoothie Board DSN pin number modifiers

repository.name: dsn-converter
repository.description: Typescript module for converting Specctra DSN into Circuit JSON

issue.body:
/claim #54

## Problem
Smoothie Board DSN files contain pin definitions with modifier lists like `(rotate 90)` at position 2 in the AST. The existing `getPinNum` always read position 2, so it grabbed the modifier list instead of the actual pin number, causing the conversion to fail.

## Fix
- Skip known modifier lists (`rotate`, `mirror`, `flip`) when extracting pin numbers
- Only coerce to number when the string is fully numeric (preserves mixed identifiers like `2@1`, `GND1`)
- Walk AST nodes instead of hardcoding index 2

## Changes
- `lib/utils/get-pin-number.ts` — rewritten pin extraction logic

Closes #54

issue.title: fix: resolve NaN pin_number for named and symbol pins (Smoothie Board)

repository.name: dsn-converter
repository.description: Typescript module for converting Specctra DSN into Circuit JSON

issue.body:
## Summary

Fixes three root-cause bugs that caused 456 out of 1055 `source_port` elements to have `NaN` `pin_number` when parsing the Smoothie Board DSN (issue #54).

### Root Causes & Fixes

**1. Tokenizer — lone `-` treated as negative number prefix** (`lib/common/parse-sexpr.ts`)

PANASONIC_E electrolytic capacitors use `+` and `-` as pin labels:
```
(pin Rect[T]Pad_3800x1400_um + 3000 0)
(pin Rect[T]Pad_3800x1400_um - -3000 0)
```
The tokenizer saw `-` followed by a space and produced `NaN` via `parseFloat("-")`. Added a digit-lookahead: if `-` is not followed by a digit or `.`, it is emitted as a Symbol token.

**2. Rotation modifier not skipped** (`lib/utils/get-pin-number.ts`)

EIA3216 capacitors use a rotation modifier between the padstack name and the pin identifier:
```
(pin Rect[T]Pad_1600x1400_um (rotate 90) A 1400 0)
```
The previous code unconditionally read `nodes[2].children[0].value` which yielded `"rotate"` instead of the actual identifier `"A"`. Known modifier keywords (`rotate`, `mirror`, `flip`) are now detected and skipped; the identifier is read from `nodes[3]`.

**3. Forced `Number()` coercion** (`convert-dsn-pcb-components-to-source-components-and-ports.ts`)

Even after correct parsing, named pin labels like `GND1`, `GND2`, `+`, `-`, `A`, `C` were passed through `Number()` in the source_port creation, producing NaN. The conversion now preserves string identifiers and only converts purely numeric strings to numbers.

### Results

| Metric | Before | After |
|--------|--------|-------|
| `source_port` with NaN `pin_number` | 456 | **0** |
| `source_port` with null `pin_number` | 0 | 0 |
| String `pin_number` (correct) | 0 | 258 (GND1, GND2, A, C, +, -) |
| Tests | 46 pass | **50 pass** (+4 new) |

### Tests Added

4 new regression tests in `tests/repros/repro7b-smoothie-pin-numbers.test.ts`:
- Verifies no NaN/null pin_numbers in Smoothie Board conversion
- Verifies CRYSTAL_3.2X2.5 named pins (GND1, GND2) are preserved as strings
- Verifies PANASONIC_E capacitor uses + and - pin labels correctly
- Verifies EIA3216 capacitor pins (rotation format) produce valid identifiers

/claim #54

Closes #54

issue.title: fix: handle named pins and (rotate) offset in Smoothie Board DSN conversion

repository.name: dsn-converter
repository.description: Typescript module for converting Specctra DSN into Circuit JSON

issue.body:
## Summary

Fixes NaN pin_number issues in Smoothie Board DSN conversion (#54). Verified locally against the freerouting [Issue145-smoothieboard.dsn](https://github.com/freerouting/freerouting/blob/master/tests/Issue145-smoothieboard.dsn) reference file — the conversion now produces **zero NaN values across 4 020 emitted circuit-json elements**, down from 458 NaN/null fields on `main`.

| Branch | NaN tokens (parser) | NaN fields (output) |
|--------|--------------------|---------------------|
| `main` | 2 | 456 (all `source_port.pin_number`) |
| this PR | **0** | **0** |

## Root causes fixed

### 1. `lib/common/parse-sexpr.ts` — lone `-` was tokenised as `Number`

In a Smoothie Board pad definition like `(pin Pad - -3000 0)`, the standalone `-` (used as a pin label) was consumed by the number branch and `parseFloat("-")` returned `NaN`. The fix gates the number branch on:

```ts
} else if (
  /\d/.test(char) ||
  (char === "-" && i + 1 < length && /\d/.test(input[i + 1]))
) {
```

so a standalone `-` falls through to the symbol parser and is correctly emitted as `{type: "Symbol", value: "-"}`. Verified locally with `(pin padstack - -3000 0)`, `(pin pad - 1400 0)`, `(- 100)`, `-1.5`, and `(rotate 90)` — all produce the expected token streams.

### 2. `lib/utils/get-pin-number.ts` — `(rotate angle)` shifted the pin index

DSN pads come in two shapes:

- `(pin padstack pin_id x y)`
- `(pin padstack (rotate angle) pin_id x y)`

The previous code only read `nodes[2]`, missing the rotation case and pulling the angle out as the pin id. The fix detects a leading `List` node and shifts the pin index from `nodes[2]` to `nodes[3]` when present. Named pins (`GND1`, `A`, `C`, `+`) are now returned as strings instead of being force-converted to numeric.

### 3. `lib/dsn-pcb/.../convert-padstacks-to-smtpads.ts` — `Number(pin.pin_number) - 1`

For string pin names this expression produced `NaN`. Replaced with `pin.pin_number` directly, so `pcb_smtpad_id` and `pcb_port_id` are stable for both numeric and string pins.

### 4. `lib/dsn-pcb/.../convert-dsn-pcb-components-to-source-components-and-ports.ts` — `pin_number: Number(pin.pin_number)`

For string pin names this produced `NaN` and silently broke the `source_port` schema (`pin_number?: number`). Replaced with a `typeof` check that emits `pin_number` only when it is genuinely numeric and `undefined` otherwise. This is the change responsible for the 456 → 0 reduction in `source_port.pin_number` NaN.

## Test

- All 47 existing tests pass on this branch (`bun test`: 47 pass / 1 skip / 0 fail / 400 expect calls)
- End-to-end conversion of the freerouting `Issue145-smoothieboard.dsn` reference file produces 0 NaN tokens and 0 NaN/null fields across 4 020 emitted circuit-json elements
- Tokenizer sanity check on 5 hand-crafted inputs (`(pin padstack - -3000 0)`, `(pin pad - 1400 0)`, `(- 100)`, `-1.5`, `(rotate 90)`) — all produce expected token streams

## Surface area

4 files changed, 116-line diff, no dependency upgrades, no behavioural change for any other DSN feature.

/claim #54

issue.title: fix: correctly parse DSN pins with rotation spec, eliminate 456 bad source_port pin_numbers

repository.name: dsn-converter
repository.description: Typescript module for converting Specctra DSN into Circuit JSON

issue.body:
## Summary

Fixes the root cause of `bad_source_ports = 456` on the Smoothieboard DSN, which remained after previous PRs addressed the NaN ID string issue.

### The Bug

DSN pin syntax allows an optional rotation specifier between the padstack name and the pin number:

```
(pin padstack_name pin_number x y)
(pin padstack_name (rotate angle) pin_number x y)
```

`getPinNum` was reading `nodes[2].children[0].value` → `"rotate"` as the pin identifier instead of looking past the rotation list to `nodes[3]` for the actual pin number. This had two effects:

1. **Wrong pin names** — every pin with `(rotate …)` got the name `"rotate"` instead of its real number (e.g. `4`, `3`, `2`, `1`) or symbol (e.g. `A`, `C`, `GND2`)
2. **Wrong coordinates** — the coordinate loop started at `i=3`, so for numeric rotation-spec pins the actual pin number was consumed as `x` and the real `x` value became `y`

### Fix

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `lib/utils/get-pin-number.ts` | Returns `{ pinNumber, hasRotation }` — when `nodes[2]` is a List (rotation spec), reads `nodes[3]` as pin number |
| `lib/dsn-pcb/.../parse-dsn-to-dsn-json.ts` | Uses `coordStart = hasRotation ? 4 : 3` so coordinates are read from the correct offset |
| `lib/dsn-pcb/.../convert-dsn-pcb-components-to-source-components-and-ports.ts` | Falls back to 1-based pin index for remaining non-numeric pin names (`"A"`, `"C"`, `"GND2"`); preserves original name in `port_hints` |

### Results on Smoothieboard

```
Before  →  After
nan_pin_number:   456  →  0
bad_source_ports: 456  →  0
```

All 46 previously-passing tests still pass. Two new focused tests added in `tests/dsn-pcb/pin-with-rotation-spec.test.ts` — one for parser correctness, one for converter behaviour with non-numeric names.

/claim #54
